describe: The image shows a square wanted poster on aged parchment with ragged, darkened edges and a pale tan centre. The word WANTED sits at the top and REWARD at the bottom, in heavy black capitals. In the middle is a sepia illustration of three figures: a large armoured figure standing behind, and two smaller figures in front. A red wax seal sits on the lower left. Lighting is soft and warm with moderate contrast, and the colours are brown, cream and red.
